# Thea Solutions

> Thea Solutions specializes in bespoke software development, enterprise-grade AI, and automation solutions engineered specifically for SMEs to streamline operations and scale with confidence.

Thea Solutions is a technology firm that bridges the gap between complex engineering and growing businesses. We deliver production-grade web systems, bespoke software, domain-specific AI integrations, and automated business workflows on modern cloud infrastructure.

## Core Navigation & Pages

- [Home](https://theasolutions.co/): Overview of Thea Solutions, core capabilities, client outcomes, and consultation intake.
- [About Us](https://theasolutions.co/about): Mission statement, engineering principles, team, and 100% IP ownership model.
- [Services & Capabilities](https://theasolutions.co/#services): Custom software development, enterprise AI, workflow automation, and cloud modernization.
- [Pricing & Engagement Models](https://theasolutions.co/pricing): Transparent sprint-based and dedicated pod engagement models with zero vendor lock-in.
- [Contact & Scoping](https://theasolutions.co/contact): Direct technical consultation and project scoping with solutions architects.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://theasolutions.co/#faqs): Delivery cycles, intellectual property rights, data security, and engagement models.
- [Careers](https://theasolutions.co/careers): Open remote-first engineering, product, and AI roles at Thea Solutions.
- [Schedule a Demo](https://theasolutions.co/schedule-demo): Book a live technical walkthrough and discussion with our solution architects.
